description.p: TablePro is a fast, native database client for Linux. It connects to PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server, ClickHouse, Redis, DuckDB, MongoDB, and Oracle, and lets you browse tables, edit data in place, run SQL, and tunnel through SSH bastions, all from a clean GTK4 / libadwaita interface.

ul.li: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server, ClickHouse, Redis, DuckDB, MongoDB, and Oracle drivers
In-place cell editing with primary-key safety
SQL editor with syntax highlighting and Run / Cancel
SSH tunneling with TOFU host-key checking
TLS, read-only mode, auto-reconnect, and saved connections
Multi-tab workspace with structure / DDL editor

description.p: Working client with four drivers, multi-tab workspace, SSH tunnels, structure editor, and query history. Pre-release ahead of the governed data-plane (policy + MCP) stages.
